text: The City of Toronto's Toronto Significant Events Investment Program, administered by the Economic Development and Culture Division, supports major events that have the ability to make a significant contribution to the economic and cultural vitality of the city. Just for Laughs Toronto submitted an application to Toronto Significant Events Investment Program, which has been reviewed by Economic Development and Culture staff, followed by a Peer Review Panel evaluation. The application has been determined eligible per the Toronto Significant Events Investment Program program criteria , being recommended for funding in the amount of $100,000 for costs related to organizing Just for Laughs' inaugural street festival in Toronto in 2022. The anticipated benefits and funding accountability measures are outlined in this report.
